scope: Official dcat-admin-demo upgraded to Laravel 10 and validated against the current local View-modernization worktree

demoControllerBaseline.policy: Every baseline file must remain in the Demo app and its page routes must stay above the frozen minimum; additions are allowed.

officialBaselineComparison.largeDifferenceThreshold: x/y > 48px, relative width > 15%, or relative height > 25%; footer Y is excluded because it follows nondeterministic page content height
officialBaselineComparison.finding: No large shell/layout shift was detected. Remaining differences are non-blocking content-height changes; several official Demo repositories generate Faker content on every request.
officialBaselineComparison.officialBaselineKnownFailure: The official 2.2.3-beta Markdown form throws a browser TypeError because the editor-md language pack executes before editormd.min.js. The local refactor fixes this ordering and passes the same page with zero page errors.

externalResourceWarnings.reason: These URLs are remote content referenced by the official Demo; local JS/CSS/HTTP failures remain blocking and were zero.

demoLaravel10Adaptations: Upgraded Laravel 6 skeleton middleware, exception-handler and route-provider contracts to Laravel 10 conventions.
Upgraded PHPUnit configuration and the default feature smoke test to the real /admin/auth/login entry.
Added the Demo's required Guzzle runtime dependency for movie API repositories.
Updated the Demo Administrator repository namespace used by the iframe user page.
Preserve the original Layer component Dropdown::withoutTextButton() call; its Dcat API and accessible icon-only Modern view are part of the Demo coverage.
Replaced the custom users resource route with its actual GET-only index route so Laravel 10 route caching has no duplicate Dcat route names.

mainPackageRegressionFixed.problem: editor-md language assets were registered before the editor runtime, causing window.editormd to be undefined
mainPackageRegressionFixed.fix: Register the field/editor runtime via parent::render() before appending the language pack

coverageNotes: All 33 non-empty routes from the official Demo app/Admin/menu.php are required by and covered by the browser harness.
Static Admin GET routes plus reachable built-in dynamic user/role/permission/menu edit/show pages are included in the 81-page sweep.
Preview routes are code fragments and are checked for HTTP/resource/JavaScript errors without requiring a full Admin shell.
The UEditor menu entry is commented out in the official Demo and is therefore not treated as an active original feature page.
The built-in permission Show route is not an active UI flow because the Dcat PermissionController disables the view action; permission index/create/edit remain covered.
releaseMeaning: This is official-Demo compatibility evidence for the recorded current PHP/Laravel environment only. Other PHP/Laravel combinations are historical references and are not required by the maintainer's 2026-09-26 decision. This evidence does not authorize a release candidate or capability promotion.

modernVerification.coverage: 303 inventory entries, 296 visible mappings, 870 dependency-signal files

modernBrowserContracts.automatedReflow: 30 cases passed across 6 families and 5 source viewports using half-width CSS viewport proxy
modernBrowserContracts.quickEdit: form and submit controls rendered in dialog
